pages.text: Spells draw on your $(l)mana$(). A $(l:magic/irons2#ars_bond_scroll_forge)Scroll$(/l) holds a single spell: cast it once, or bind it into a spellbook at an $(l:magic/irons#ars_bond_inscription_table)Inscription Table$(/l) and keep it.$(br2)Spells come in levels and rarities, across nine schools from fire to eldritch.
$(l:magic/irons#mithril_ore)Mithril$(/l) lies deep in the deepslate and needs a netherite pickaxe. Arcane Essence comes from magic mobs, old loot, and Ars Nouveau's Imbuement Chamber.
Below y -38. Needs a netherite pickaxe. Blast the raw mithril into scrap; four scraps make an ingot.
